{0b 02 00}{04 1a 00}-

{07 0b 00}Well? {01 00 00 05 00}Shall we see who's the
better fisher? {01 01 00}{07 00 00}Let's see...{01 00 00 0a 00}
What should the terms be?
OK! Whoever can catch
{04 1a 00}
